conditional_mapping_policy: explicit named C6 source coordinate and declared affine assumptions; source support required
historical_target: standardized six-task mean, separate from q90 forecast target
frontier_target: type-specific recent two-calendar-month q90, anchored conditional evolution
frontier_model_selection: lowest diagnostic two-month-window RMSE; four overlapping test windows per type, not blind selection
forecast_origin: latest observed submission per type; supplied per row
paper_status: not updated at user request; old v2 paper and root tables are not current v3 core results
